description: Search Schematik's public electronics parts catalogue (boards, sensors, displays, modules) by name, brand, part number or use. Returns a JSON list of parts, best matches first; pass a result's slug to get_part for its pinout and price.

limit.description: How many parts to return at most. Fewer come back when fewer parts match.

query.description: Words to match, e.g. a part name, brand, part number or use such as 'BME280' or 'oled display'. Parts matching any word are returned, best matches first.

name: search_parts
title: Search parts
